name: DailySiteDiary
tagline: The construction daily report – weather, manpower, plant, deliveries, delays and sign-off – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete daily site diary app for contractors: one diary per site per day with weather, manpower by trade, plant and equipment, deliveries, visitors, delays and work performed; completeness check, submit, independent approval, return for correction and locking; month calendar with missing working days, manpower heat-map, delay register for EOT claims and a dashboard. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen and connects to any collection, Dataverse view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Repeatable line editors for manpower, plant, deliveries, visitors and delays
Independent approval and locking with audited unlock
Manpower matrix by trade and day
Delay register export for extension-of-time claims
